name: C.A.R.C.A.S.S.
blurb: A legendary private military company bound by pact to Carcenkarrion, the bone carapace devil. Their skeletons fuse and grow into weapon-laden constructs and reanimate marksmen — masters of power armor, formation tactics, gun kata and overwhelming firepower.

specialMechanic.name: Formation
specialMechanic.text: While adjacent to an ally, gain +1D on attacks.

specialTags.Reload: Once used, a unit cannot use any ability with this tag until it reloads. To reload, sacrifice a MOVE.
specialTags.Headshot: An effect that triggers when the final attack roll is a 6.

traits.name: Formation
traits.text: While adjacent to an ally, gain +1D on attacks.

traits.name: Hot Clip
traits.text: Once a round, reloading grants you 1 strength.

acts.name: Akimbo
acts.text: On hit: 2 damage. On hit (4+): one other foe in range takes 1 damage, (6+) one other foe in range takes 1 damage.

souls.name: Reload Slide
souls.text: Own or allied turn. Step 1, then you or an adjacent ally reload.

souls.name: Bullet Time
souls.text: Own turn. Clear one (5+) or two negative tokens. Ranged attacks automatically miss you until the end of your next turn, and you are immune to splash and line damage for the duration.

upgrades.name: Vomit Bullets

upgrades.name: Scavenge Rounds

acts.name: Flashbang

acts.name: Shieldwall

upgrades.name: Shield Charge

upgrades.name: Napalm Injector

acts.name: Snipe

acts.name: Transform to Gun

acts.name: Deathmark

upgrades.name: Extended Barrel

traits.name: Large

acts.name: Juggernaut

acts.text: Line 5: 1 fire damage, and inflicts 1 vulnerable on the first unit in the line. Pierces through walls and can target through walls.

upgrades.name: Fortify
upgrades.text: Juggernaut also clears all negative tokens.

upgrades.name: Heavy Caliber Cannon
upgrades.text: Catechism pushes all units in the line 1 space and destroys walls.

upgrades.name: Gunner Pivot
upgrades.text: When at least one ally is adjacent to this unit, Mortar ignores cover.
